cases.sentence: О милости и правосудии воспою, Тебе, Господи, я буду ___
cases.translation: Of mercy and justice I will sing to You, O Lord, I will sing
cases.explain: After the verb буду (will) takes the infinitive form петь (to sing).

cases.translation: I will walk in a blameless way
cases.explain: The verb пойду (I will go) takes the instrumental case for the path taken.

cases.sentence: Когда придешь ты ко ___, в доме своем буду ходить с чистым сердцем
cases.translation: When You come to me, in my house I will walk with a pure heart
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: В доме своем буду ходить с чистым ___
cases.translation: In my house I will walk with a pure heart
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: не положу ничего порочного пред глазами ___
cases.translation: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes
cases.explain: The preposition пред (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret
cases.explain: The verb клевещет (slanders) takes the accusative case for the direct object.

cases.sentence: высокомерного взгляда и гордого ___ не потерплю
cases.translation: haughty eyes and a proud heart I will not tolerate
cases.explain: Гордого сердца (of a proud heart) uses the genitive case in the possessive construction.

cases.sentence: ходящий по праведному пути будет служить ___
cases.translation: he who walks in the righteous way will serve me
cases.explain: The verb служить (to serve) takes the dative case for the person being served.

reading.ru: О милости и правосудии воспою, Тебе, Господи, я буду петь.
reading.question: What themes will the psalmist sing about?
reading.explain: The psalmist declares О милости и правосудии воспою (I will sing about mercy and justice).

reading.ru: Пойду непорочным путем. Когда придешь ты ко мне?
reading.question: What does the psalmist promise to do and what does he ask?
options: He will walk in a blameless way and asks when God will come to him
He will run away from God
reading.correct: He will walk in a blameless way and asks when God will come to him
reading.explain: The psalmist says Пойду непорочным путем... Когда придешь ты ко мне? (I will walk in a blameless way... When will You come to me?)

reading.ru: Ненавижу дела неверных, не пристанут они ко мне.
reading.question: What does the psalmist say about the works of the unfaithful?
options: He hates them and they will not cling to him
He loves them and will follow them
reading.correct: He hates them and they will not cling to him
reading.explain: The psalmist states Ненавижу дела неверных, не пристанут они ко мне (I hate the works of the unfaithful; they will not cling to me).

reading.ru: Кто тайно клевещет на своего ближнего, того истреблю.
reading.question: What will happen to those who slander their neighbors in secret?
reading.explain: The psalmist says Кто тайно клевещет на своего ближнего, того истреблю (Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will destroy).

reading.ru: Глаза мои будут на верных земли, чтобы они были при мне, ходящий по праведному пути будет служить мне.
reading.question: Whom will the psalmist keep his eyes upon and who will serve him?
options: The faithful of the earth and those who walk in righteousness
reading.correct: The faithful of the earth and those who walk in righteousness
reading.explain: The psalmist says Глаза мои будут на верных земли... ходящий по праведному пути будет служить мне (My eyes will be on the faithful of the land... he who walks in the righteous way will serve me).

reading.ru: Каждое утро буду истреблять всех нечестивых земли и скореню всех беззаконных из города Господня.
reading.question: What will the psalmist do each morning?
options: Destroy all the wicked of the earth and root out all lawbreakers from God's city
reading.correct: Destroy all the wicked of the earth and root out all lawbreakers from God's city
reading.explain: The psalmist declares Каждое утро буду истреблять всех нечестивых земли... (Every morning I will destroy all the wicked of the earth and root out all lawbreakers).
